WORST MARK VILLAR PROJECT IN MANILA

Two days ago, sumigaw at nagalit si Sec. Vince Dizon sa mga Manila DPWH engineers.

Hingi kasi sila ng hingi ng budget para sa repair and maintenance ng “Sunog Apog Pumping Station” eh hindi naman gumagana since 2020.

Binigyan sila ng 94 Million ngayong 2025 Budget at humihingi pa ng 200 Million for 2026!

BUT, the project itself was already funded with a whopping 774 Million in 2017.

Nagsimula yung construction nuong 2018 tapos nag inauguration 2020 pero never gumana kahit hanggang ngayon.

According to PhilStar, barangay officials said they never needed the pumping station in the first place. They claimed they were not consulted before construction began.

And sa investigation ni Sec. Vince Dizon, imbes na makatulong eh nakaka perwisyo at dagdag pa yung Pumping Station sa problema ng baha.

Guess who funded and inaugurated the pumping station when he was a DPWH Secretary?

Tahimik lang kayo. Si Mark Villar lang naman.

At proud na proud pa sila niyan ni Rodrigo Duterte ah. Tingnan nyo naman yung bronze marker or plaque.

Ang Congressman duon? Rolando Valeriano.

Ang Mayor nuong 2019-2022? Isko Moreno.

Facts lang.

#Accountability
#FloodControlProjects

🚦 Traffic Advisory Meeting – Dasara Festival 🚦

In view of the upcoming Dasara festival, a meeting was conducted at Miyapur Police Station by:
 DCP Medchal Traffic, Addl DCP Medchal Traffic, ACP Kukatpally Traffic, ACP Balanagar Traffic, ACP Medchal Traffic, SHO Kukatpally Traffic, SHO Balanagar Traffic, SHO Miyapur Traffic with all private travel operators and APSRTC/TSRTC officials.
Key Instructions:

APSRTC/TSRTC buses must halt only at designated bus stops and move immediately after boarding.

Private travel operators must ensure no driver operates under the influence of alcohol.

All buses should be parked in a single column, not side by side.

Private travels shift pickup points from busy traffic areas to normal-traffic locations.

Pickup & drop points of private buses shifted from Miyapur X-Road to Miyapur Metro Bus Stop.

Commuters are advised to follow traffic rules & drive safely.

SOUTH & CENTRAL ASIA

Traffic Advisory

26 September 2025

FATAL TRUCK CRASH ON THE N1 NORTH FREEWAY BEFORE WINNIE MANDELA DRIVE

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) confirms a fatal accident on the N1 Northbound before Winnie Mandela Drive involving a truck and two other vehicles, with two fatalities reported. 

The truck has overturned, spilling its load of cooking oil onto the roadway. As a result, two lanes are currently closed to traffic.

Emergency Management Services and law enforcement personnel are on the scene, but motorists should expect severe delays and are strongly advised to exercise caution and use alternative routes.

END

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic #SaferJoburg #NomakanjaniManjeNamhlanje
